cells.quote: My cousin and I are the ones pushing.
Maybe one person. But a good IT person will not stay in a small town for what we can pay.
The software companies make products for the big national distributors, not for people like us.
the big distribution software charges per user every month. With forty users on margins of three or four percent, that is not possible for us.
We stopped paying the developer for changes, I just make them myself now.
Last year I built our own order tracker with one of these AI app builders.
The older partners are happy if billing works.
Anything big needs all four partners to agree.
